integrity: General claim established by the complete analytic conditional-Gram proof; exact small-case matrix tests corroborate but do not replace it. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
limitations: Exact result only for q>=3, n>=4, and 2<=k<=n-2, with Fourier coordinate-degree at most two; no claims about boundary shells or higher Fourier degree. Historical equivalence in a broader Terwilliger-algebra formulation is an outstanding literature risk.
title: Six-level Fourier concentration spectrum on q-ary Hamming shells
